channel.title: HTML to Figma Blog
channel.description: Practical tutorials and guides for designers and developers using the HTML to Figma plugin. Learn how to convert HTML, CSS, and web components into editable Figma designs.

item.title: Importing Multi-page Websites into Figma: Full Workflow
item.description: How to import an entire multi-page website into Figma using html2design. Page-by-page workflow, consistency tips, Figma page organization, and sitemap-driven import strategy for redesign projects.

item.title: How to Import a Component Library into Figma
item.description: Step-by-step guide to importing an entire component library into Figma using html2design. Covers preparing components, batch import from Storybook, design token extraction, and publishing a Figma library for your team.

item.title: Figma Dev Mode vs html2design: When to Use Which
item.description: Figma Dev Mode and html2design solve different problems — one goes design-to-code, the other goes code-to-design. Side-by-side feature comparison and the complementary workflow for teams that need both directions.

item.title: Accessibility Audit: From HTML Audit to Figma Redesign
item.description: Run a WCAG accessibility audit on your HTML pages, import flagged sections into Figma using html2design, and redesign for compliance. Step-by-step guide covering contrast, focus indicators, touch targets, and annotated developer handoff.

item.title: Design Tokens: Bridging Code and Figma with HTML to Figma
item.description: Sync design tokens between your codebase and Figma Variables and Styles using the token reference page pattern and html2design. Covers the code-to-Figma token mapping, rendered-output approach, and sync strategies for design system teams.

item.title: Webflow to Figma: Import Your Webflow Site into Figma
item.description: Import any published Webflow site into Figma as native, editable layers using html2design. Covers section-by-section import, capturing interaction states, CMS template pages, and building a Figma design system from Webflow output.

item.title: Responsive Design to Figma: Converting Breakpoints to Figma Variants
item.description: Step-by-step guide to converting responsive web designs into Figma Variants. Capture each breakpoint with html2design and build a responsive component library with mobile, tablet, and desktop variants.

item.title: HTML Email Template to Figma: Import & Edit Email Designs
item.description: Step-by-step guide to converting HTML email templates into editable Figma designs using html2design. Covers table-based layouts, inline styles, gotchas, and email-specific Figma workflow tips.

item.title: CSS Grid & Flexbox to Figma Auto Layout: Conversion Guide
item.description: Step-by-step guide to converting CSS Grid and Flexbox layouts into Figma Auto Layout. Covers layout import, post-conversion cleanup, and applying Figma Auto Layout for true responsiveness.

item.title: Design System Migration: From Code to Figma Components
item.description: Step-by-step guide to migrating a design system from code to Figma. Extract design tokens from HTML/CSS, identify components, and build a native Figma component library.

item.title: Screenshot vs Code Import: Which Figma Conversion Method Actually Wins?
item.description: Side-by-side comparison of screenshot and code import methods for Figma. Covers output quality, editability, typography, layer structure, and a practical decision framework.

item.title: Bootstrap to Figma: A Migration Guide for Bootstrap Teams
item.description: How to convert Bootstrap components and grid layouts into editable Figma designs using html2design. Covers outerHTML export, responsive breakpoints, and Bootstrap utility mapping.

item.title: Tailwind to Figma: Build a Design System from Your Tailwind Components
item.description: Extract Tailwind design tokens as Figma Variables and Styles, convert your component library to native Figma layers, and keep code and design in sync.

item.title: How to Convert React Components to Figma Designs
item.description: Step-by-step guide to converting React components into native, editable Figma layers using html2design. Works with localhost, Storybook, Next.js, and Tailwind.

item.title: How to Import a Website into Figma: Two Methods Compared
item.description: Step-by-step guide to importing any website into Figma as editable layers. Compares Chrome extension and code-paste approaches.

item.title: How to Convert HTML to Figma: A Developer's Guide
item.description: Step-by-step guide to converting HTML and CSS code into native, editable Figma designs using the html2design plugin.
